intro: Home tuition in this south-east pocket covers four quite different places. Koramangala is an older post-independence suburb whose quiet cross roads still carry bungalows and independent houses, with newer apartment buildings slotted between them and cafes and co-working offices on the busier stretches. HSR Layout mixes independent houses, builder floors and plotted homes with apartment communities, and parks are spread through its sectors. Bellandur, bounded by its lake on the north, was largely rural before the tech parks arrived, and Sarjapur Road beyond it is lined with high-rise towers and villa townships. So the first visit here may begin at a doorbell or at a security desk.

Getting a tutor to the door is mostly a road question. Koramangala and the HSR side can draw on tutors who ride the Yellow Line to Central Silk Board and finish by auto, while Bellandur and the Sarjapur Road localities such as Kasavanahalli, Carmelaram and Chikkabellandur have no working metro stop and depend on tutors travelling by bus, cab or two-wheeler. Office traffic on the Outer Ring Road peaks in the morning and again from early evening, so a lesson set after that peak, or on a weekend morning, holds up better week to week. For senior specialist subjects, pairing a weekly home visit with an online session is a sensible mix.

When you send a request from this zone, NXTutors lists tutors who live inside Koramangala, HSR Layout, Bellandur or Sarjapur Road first, then tutors who already travel into the zone, then the rest of Bengaluru, and finally online tutors. From that list you receive two or three matched tutors, each profile showing the tutor's own fee before anything is booked. The first lesson is a free demo on your child's current chapter. If the match stops working later, moving to another tutor costs nothing. Mention your block, sector or tower in the request so that distance is judged correctly from the start.
faqs: Is there a metro station close to Bellandur or Sarjapur Road yet?

Not an open one. The Blue Line along the Outer Ring Road, with HSR Layout, Agara and Ibbaluru stations, is still under construction, and no section is running. Until it opens, tutors reach Bellandur and Sarjapur Road by road, so a tutor living nearby is the practical pick for regular weekday lessons in these gated communities.
Does a working metro station serve Koramangala and HSR Layout?

Yes, at the zone's western corner. Central Silk Board station opened on the Yellow Line in August 2025 and is planned as an interchange with the Blue Line. It helps tutors heading to Koramangala and the HSR side, who usually finish the trip by auto, while families further east along the ORR still depend on road travel.
What will a tutor cost for a family in HSR Layout or Bellandur?

Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more. Each tutor sets their own fee and you see it on the profile before the free demo.
Should we choose home or online tuition on Sarjapur Road?

Both can work. Nearly every home there is in a gated society with no metro nearby, so a home tutor who lives on the corridor or in Bellandur keeps visits regular. For advanced senior subjects, an online tutor from elsewhere in India adds choice, and one home visit plus one online session a week is a practical rhythm.

intro: Parents in this zone mostly live in the south's settled layouts. Jayanagar's numbered blocks are largely independent houses on tree-lined streets, with low-rise flats added over time and the shops concentrated in the 3rd and 4th Blocks. Basavanagudi, near Lalbagh and the old flower and vegetable market street, holds older homes with gardens, some of them heritage houses. JP Nagar stretches in phases from inside the Outer Ring Road towards Puttenahalli, Gottigere and Anjanapura, Banashankari runs in six stages from Mysore Road to Kanakapura Road, and Kumaraswamy Layout, with pockets such as Vasanthapura and Subramanyapura, is mostly detached houses and mid-sized buildings. Along Kanakapura Road, apartment projects and gated communities take over.

For most homes here a tutor simply rings the doorbell, which makes the first visit easy to arrange. The Green Line runs the length of the zone, with stops at Jayanagar, Banashankari, JP Nagar and Yelachenahalli, and further south at Konanakunte Cross, Doddakallasandra, Vajarahalli and Thalaghattapura, so a tutor who lives near the line can often reach you with only a short walk or auto at the end. Street parking around the Jayanagar 4th Block shops and the Basavanagudi market is tight in the evening, which favours tutors who come by metro. In the outer phases and stages, where distances grow, an online lesson between home visits keeps the week on track.

On NXTutors, a request from Jayanagar, Basavanagudi, JP Nagar, Banashankari, Kumaraswamy Layout or Kanakapura Road starts with tutors who live in the zone. Next come tutors who already travel here, then tutors from elsewhere in Bengaluru, and online tutors last. You are sent two or three of them, matched on class, board and subject, whether that means SSLC, PUC, CBSE, ICSE or IB. Each tutor's fee is on the profile before you book, the first lesson is a free demo, and if the tutor stops suiting your child later, a switch is free.
faqs: Which metro line serves Jayanagar, JP Nagar and Banashankari?

The Green Line. Its stations through Jayanagar, Banashankari, JP Nagar and Yelachenahalli opened on 18 June 2017, and the Kanakapura Road stretch to Thalaghattapura followed on 15 January 2021. A tutor living along the line can come by metro and finish on foot or by a short auto, which suits the zone's tight evening parking.
Is Kumaraswamy Layout easy for a home tutor to reach?

Usually, yes. It sits close to three Green Line stations, Banashankari, JP Nagar and Yelachenahalli, and is served by city buses. Most homes are detached houses or small buildings, so the tutor walks straight to the door and parking is simpler than near the busy shopping streets. Kanakapura Road traffic at peak hours favours an earlier slot.
Can we try a tutor before paying for regular lessons?

Yes. The first lesson with the tutor you pick is a free demo, taught on your child's current chapter rather than a sample topic. You will already have seen that tutor's fee on the profile, so after the demo you judge teaching and cost together, and nothing is owed if you decide not to continue.
Does Basavanagudi suit home tuition or online lessons?

Home tuition suits it well. Green Line stations lie close by, and the older independent houses mean a direct doorstep visit with no gate list. Online lessons make most sense for specialist subjects, or when you want a particular board expert from another city. A steady weekly slot fits the area's settled routine and avoids the evening market crowd.

intro: This zone follows two roads south from the city: Hosur Road towards Electronic City and Bannerghatta Road towards Gottigere. BTM Layout, between them, mixes independent houses and bungalows with low- and mid-rise apartments and a large population of students and young professionals. Along Bannerghatta Road, Arekere's older layouts, Puttenahalli and Bilekahalli sit beside apartment blocks built after the early 2000s. Bommanahalli and Begur combine gated communities with older houses, and Electronic City's phases wrap big apartment communities, some villas and village pockets such as Konappana Agrahara and Doddathogur around the IT campuses. Expect a society gate in most newer buildings and a doorbell in the older layouts.

Since August 2025 the Yellow Line has made Hosur Road the easier side for tutors. Stations at BTM Layout, Central Silk Board, Bommanahalli, Hongasandra, Hosa Road, Beratena Agrahara and Electronic City put most homes within an auto ride of the metro, and tutors from the Jayanagar side can change onto it from the Green Line. Bannerghatta Road is different: the Pink Line's elevated stretch there is built but not yet open, so for now tutors come by road or via the Yellow Line. Office shift times in Electronic City and the Silk Board junction decide the good hours, so fix the lesson away from them.

Tell NXTutors your stage, layout or phase and we look first for tutors who live in BTM Layout, Arekere, Bommanahalli, Begur, Electronic City or along Bannerghatta Road. After them come tutors who travel into the zone, then the wider Bengaluru list, then online tutors. You receive two or three matches, each with the tutor's own fee visible before any booking. The first class is a free demo, so your child meets the tutor before you commit to anything, and moving to a different tutor later is free if the fit changes during the year.
faqs: Which Yellow Line stations help home tutors in this zone?

BTM Layout and Central Silk Board for BTM and the northern end, Bommanahalli and Hongasandra for the Hosur Road homes and Begur, and Hosa Road, Beratena Agrahara, Konappana Agrahara and Electronic City for the southern phases. The line opened in August 2025, and a short auto usually covers the last stretch to the gate.
Is there a working metro on Bannerghatta Road?

Not yet. The Pink Line's elevated section from Kalena Agrahara to Tavarekere, with a Hulimavu station, is built but still awaiting opening. Until it runs, tutors reach Arekere and the nearby layouts by road, or ride the Yellow Line and take an auto across, so a tutor living on the Bannerghatta side is the steadier weekly choice.
How much do home tutors charge in BTM Layout and Electronic City?

Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more. Each tutor sets their own rate, and it is shown on the profile before the free demo.
Does Begur suit home tuition or online lessons?

Both work. Begur Road links the area with Hosur Road on one side and Bannerghatta Road on the other, and the nearest metro stops are the Yellow Line stations on Hosur Road, so tutors from HSR Layout, BTM Layout or Bommanahalli can reach it. Apartment complexes need a gate entry, houses do not.

intro: Three localities make up this compact eastern zone. Indiranagar, a late-1970s layout, keeps independent houses beside apartment buildings and builder floors, with Binnamangala, Kodihalli and Thippasandra around it. Domlur, one of the older eastern localities, has a blend of houses, builder floors and flats, with offices nearby, and Jogupalya lies next to it. CV Raman Nagar, east towards Kaggadasapura, ranges from a government research staff township to older apartment blocks, independent houses and newer gated communities, with a large tech park inside it. For a visiting tutor, that means a doorbell on some streets and a visitor log or gate list on others.

The Purple Line is the zone's lifeline for tutors. Indiranagar has two stations of its own and Baiyappanahalli serves CV Raman Nagar, so a tutor coming from Whitefield, KR Puram or the western suburbs can ride straight in. Domlur has no station; tutors either take an auto from Indiranagar or use the large bus terminus at Domlur. Evening crowds on 100 Feet Road and 80 Feet Road, and office traffic at the Domlur flyover and on Old Madras Road, are the main timing factors, so after-school, mid-afternoon or weekend lessons are easier to keep regular than slots at office closing time.

NXTutors ranks the tutors it suggests by how close they are to you. For Indiranagar, Domlur and CV Raman Nagar, that means tutors who live in the zone come first, followed by tutors who already travel here, then the wider city, and online tutors when nobody local fits. From that list you get two or three matches for your child's class, board and subject. Their fees are on the profiles before you choose, the first lesson is a free demo, and switching to another tutor later costs nothing. Add your stage or cross road so the distance is read correctly.
faqs: Which metro stations help tutors reach Indiranagar and CV Raman Nagar?

Two Purple Line stations sit inside Indiranagar, both from the first Namma Metro section of 20 October 2011, and Baiyappanahalli is nearest for CV Raman Nagar. That lets tutors from either end of the line reach these homes with little more than a brief walk or auto hop, so weekday home lessons are practical from much of the city.
How do tutors get to Domlur without a metro station?

Usually by metro to Indiranagar and then an auto, or by city bus to the big Domlur terminus. The flyover junction at Domlur, where three main roads cross, is heavy at office closing time, so a mid-afternoon or weekend lesson is easier to keep on schedule week after week, especially in the board-exam months.
How many tutor profiles will we be sent for a request in this zone?

Two or three. We match class, board and subject first, then distance, so the list starts with tutors living in Indiranagar, Domlur or CV Raman Nagar. The fee sits on each profile before you pick one for the free demo, and you can ask for a different tutor later without paying anything extra for the change.
Do homes in CV Raman Nagar need gate registration for a tutor?

Many do. The research staff township and the gated communities expect the family to give the tutor's name at the gate beforehand, while independent houses are an ordinary doorstep visit. Shift changes at the local tech park crowd Old Madras Road, so an after-school lesson that ends before them runs more smoothly.

intro: Five localities stretch along the eastern IT belt here. Whitefield, a village until the late 1990s, is now apartment towers, gated villa communities, independent houses and builder floors, with Kadugodi, Hoodi, Varthur and Hagadur around it. Brookefield, another old Anglo-Indian settlement, is mostly apartment complexes, plus a few villas and plots. Marathahalli packs apartment complexes, builder floors and side-lane houses around Kundalahalli, Munnekollal and Kadubeesanahalli. Mahadevapura, once a separate municipal council, is largely gated communities, and KR Puram, headquarters of Bengaluru East taluk, has apartments with older houses and plots near Vengayyana Lake. Most families here will register a tutor at a security desk, and some ask for photo ID.

The Purple Line runs through the heart of the zone, from Krishnarajapura through Singayyanapalya, Garudacharapalya, Hoodi, Kundalahalli and Hopefarm Channasandra to the Whitefield (Kadugodi) terminus, and it has been continuous from the city centre since October 2023. Homes near those stations can draw on tutors from Indiranagar or further west. Marathahalli is the gap, since its Blue Line stop is still being built, so tutors reach it by road. Around the Outer Ring Road junction, a tutor based on your side of the ORR and a late-afternoon or weekend slot make the practical pairing.

When a Whitefield, Brookefield, Marathahalli, Mahadevapura or KR Puram family asks NXTutors for help, the shortlist is built outward from the home: tutors living in the zone, then those who already travel here, then tutors elsewhere in Bengaluru, and online ones last. Two or three tutors reach you, matched on class, board and subject. Every tutor's fee is visible on the profile before you book, and the free demo lets your child try the tutor on a real chapter. If a better fit appears later in the year, changing tutor is free and the shortlist is rebuilt the same way.
faqs: Is Marathahalli on the metro yet?

No. Its station belongs to the Blue Line stretch from Central Silk Board to KR Puram, which is still under construction and not running. Trains do stop at the Bellandur Road halt, but most tutors come on a two-wheeler, bus or cab, so one who lives on your side of the Outer Ring Road keeps weekday lessons more regular.
Which station suits a tutor visiting Brookefield?

Kundalahalli, a Purple Line stop since March 2023, is the nearest for Brookefield, and Hopefarm Channasandra helps homes towards Whitefield. A tutor riding in from the city usually covers the final part on foot or by auto. Brookefield homes are mostly gated complexes, so put the tutor's name with security ahead of the demo class.
What fee should a Whitefield family expect for a senior-class tutor?

Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more. The exact figure is the tutor's own, shown on the profile before the free demo.
Can tutors reach KR Puram directly by metro?

Yes. Krishnarajapura has had a Purple Line station since March 2023, and since the Benniganahalli link opened that October, trains run without a break to Baiyappanahalli and the centre. Tutors living near the line in Indiranagar or Whitefield can ride in; allow a margin for the walk or auto near the busy Old Madras Road junction at office peaks.

intro: The north-east zone is a set of residential colonies rather than an office district. Kalyan Nagar, often taken to include HRBR Layout and Chelekere, is organised colony streets of independent houses and builder floors, with newer apartment blocks and busy cafe streets; Kammanahalli is next door. HRBR Layout's numbered blocks and parks hold mostly houses and multi-floor buildings on individual sites. Banaswadi mixes bungalows, independent houses, builder floors and flats. Hennur, just outside the Outer Ring Road, has apartment complexes and villa communities on Hennur Road and houses and plots in the layouts behind, while Thanisandra, near Nagawara and Kothanur, is mostly flats in gated societies.

With no metro running through the zone, the tutor's own journey matters more than usual. The nearest open stations are Baiyappanahalli and Benniganahalli on the Purple Line, so a tutor coming by metro still needs an auto or bus for the last part, and Banaswadi railway station helps a few. The Blue Line from KR Puram towards the airport, with Horamavu, HRBR Layout, Kalyana Nagara, HBR Layout and Nagawara stations, is under construction. Until it runs, tutors from Hennur, Kalyan Nagar, Kothanur or Banaswadi itself are the dependable choice for weekday lessons, and after-school slots avoid the heaviest Outer Ring Road traffic.

NXTutors fills the shortlist in the same order for every family here: tutors who live in Hennur, Kalyan Nagar, HRBR Layout, Banaswadi or Thanisandra first, then tutors who already travel to this part of the city, then the rest of Bengaluru, and online tutors to close any gap. You receive two or three of them, each with the fee shown before you decide. The free demo is a normal lesson on this week's topic, and should the tutor stop suiting your child, we help you switch at no charge. Give the block and cross number so distance is judged accurately.
faqs: Is there a metro station in Hennur or Kalyan Nagar?

Not yet. Stations named HRBR Layout and Kalyana Nagara are being built on the Blue Line from KR Puram towards the airport, but that line is still under construction. For now tutors come by bus, two-wheeler or cab, or ride the Purple Line to Baiyappanahalli or Benniganahalli and finish the trip by auto.
Do HRBR Layout homes need gate registration for a tutor?

Rarely. Most homes are independent houses and builder buildings on individual sites, so the family simply meets the tutor at the door. The layout's block and cross numbering makes addresses easy to find, which helps a tutor arriving for the first time. Apartment buildings are the exception and may keep a visitor register.
What happens if the first tutor we choose does not work out?

Tell us and we suggest another tutor who fits your child's class, board and location; switching tutor is free. You see the new tutor's fee on the profile before anything is agreed, so a change never commits you to a price you have not seen, and the nearest-first order still applies.
What should Thanisandra families arrange before the demo?

Give the tutor's name and phone number to the security desk, since most homes are flats in gated societies, and share the tower and flat number. Thanisandra Main Road carries heavy office traffic, so weekend and after-school slots are easiest, and online classes help when you want a specialist subject tutor from further away.

intro: Home tutoring in this northern zone covers three different kinds of neighbourhood. Hebbal, around its lake, ranges from high-rise societies and mid-range flats to independent houses and villas, with Kanaka Nagar, Kaval Byrasandra, Ganga Nagar and Mathikere as neighbours. RT Nagar is a long-established family area in two blocks, where houses and builder floors often have shops on the ground floor and homes above, with markets and parks inside the locality. Yelahanka splits into an Old Town of older homes and a New Town of independent houses and plots, with apartment complexes growing around it and Jakkur, Puttenahalli and Attur nearby.

No metro runs here yet. Hebbala, Kodigehalli, Jakkuru Cross and Yelahanka are stations on the Blue Line towards the airport, all under construction, so tutors arrive by bus, two-wheeler, auto or, for Yelahanka, by train to the junction. The Hebbal flyover, where the Outer Ring Road meets Bellary Road, carries airport and office traffic, and it is the biggest single factor in whether a weekday lesson starts on time. A tutor who lives on your side of it, or in Yelahanka itself for New Town families, makes regular home visits realistic; for specialist senior subjects, an online tutor widens the choice.

NXTutors keeps that geography in mind when it builds your list. Tutors who live in Hebbal, RT Nagar or Yelahanka come first, then tutors who already travel into the zone, then others across Bengaluru, and online tutors last. You get two or three of them, matched to your child's class, board and subjects, and every profile shows the tutor's fee before you pick one. The first lesson is a free demo at home or online, whichever you asked for, and moving to another tutor later is free if the timings or teaching style stop working for your family.
faqs: Does any metro line serve Hebbal or Yelahanka today?

No. Hebbala and Yelahanka are among the Blue Line stations under construction on the route towards the airport, and none is open. Hebbal has a railway station and Yelahanka Junction is a railway junction, but most tutors come by road, so a tutor living on your side of the Hebbal flyover is the steadier weekday choice.
How do tutors usually reach RT Nagar?

By city bus, two-wheeler or auto, since RT Nagar has no metro station. Most homes are independent houses or small buildings, so the tutor reaches the doorstep directly, though parking on the busier market lanes needs care. Tutors living in RT Nagar or Hebbal can fit weekday evening visits without crossing the flyover at peak time.
What do home tutors in Yelahanka and Hebbal charge?

Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more. A tutor crossing the flyover at peak time may allow for the journey; one from your own locality usually will not.
What address details help a tutor find a Yelahanka home?

For New Town, the stage and house number; for Old Town, a nearby landmark as well. New Town houses are usually a doorstep visit, while apartment societies ask for gate registration. With airport traffic on Bellary Road, a tutor living in Yelahanka suits regular weekday classes better than one driving up from the city.

intro: Families in this north-west zone mostly live in houses or small buildings rather than towers. Malleshwaram's grid of crosses and mains mixes older independent houses, many being rebuilt as small apartment blocks, with newer 2 and 3 BHK flats, and Seshadripuram is next door. Sadashivanagar is mostly big houses and bungalows along broad, quiet streets. In Rajajinagar's numbered blocks, some original plots still carry a single family house while others now hold flats. Mahalakshmi Layout, with Nandini Layout and Kurubarahalli nearby, is chiefly houses and builder-built floors, and Yeshwanthpur runs from older homes in pockets like Subedarpalya to gated apartment complexes near Peenya and Jalahalli.

For tutor travel, the Green Line is the thread through the zone. Sampige Road and Srirampura serve Malleshwaram, Rajajinagar and Mahalakshmi stations sit on Chord Road, and Yeshwanthpur station faces the railway junction on Tumkur Road, with Goraguntepalya next. Tutors coming from the south can reach all of these without leaving the metro, then walk or take a short auto. Sadashivanagar has no station inside, so tutors use a Malleshwaram stop and an auto or come along Bellary Road. Chord Road, Tumkur Road and the Malleshwaram market roads slow down in the evening, so setting the lesson a little before or after the peak helps.

Ask NXTutors for a tutor in Malleshwaram, Sadashivanagar, Rajajinagar, Mahalakshmi Layout or Yeshwanthpur and the first names on your list live in this zone. Tutors who travel here regularly follow, then the remainder of the city, then online tutors. We send two or three who match your child's class, board and subjects, with each fee shown on the profile before you choose. Your child's first lesson is a free demo, which lets you judge the teaching before paying for anything, and if you want a different tutor later in the year, the switch is free.
faqs: Which Green Line station is nearest to Mahalakshmi Layout?

The layout shares its name with Mahalakshmi station on Chord Road, and Rajajinagar is one stop along. Tutors living near the line can arrive by train and cover the rest by auto. Since most homes are houses or builder floors, the tutor rings the bell rather than signing in at a society gate, which keeps the first visit simple.
Do Sadashivanagar homes need the tutor's name in advance?

Often, yes. Many of the large homes employ a guard, so pass on the tutor's name before the first lesson. With no metro stop inside the locality, tutors ride to a Malleshwaram station and finish by auto, or drive in along Bellary Road, which is heavy in the evening, so an early or late slot is easier to keep.
Can one tutor teach both at home and online for a Rajajinagar family?

Yes. When you send the request you say whether lessons should be at home, online or both, and we match tutors who teach that way. Each tutor's fee is on the profile before the free demo, and a weekly home visit plus a short online doubt session is a pattern many families use.
Is Yeshwanthpur easy for a tutor to reach?

In most cases, yes. Its Green Line station faces the old railway junction across Tumkur Road, and Goraguntepalya is next to the north, so tutors living along the line arrive by metro and an auto. Tumkur Road is congested at peak hours, so a weekday evening lesson that starts slightly later tends to begin on time.

intro: West Bengaluru is mostly plotted layouts where the tutor rings a doorbell. Basaveshwaranagar, west of Rajajinagar, is a settled, green area of independent houses and 2 and 3 BHK apartment buildings on hilly streets. Vijayanagar, with sub-localities such as Hampinagar, Saraswatinagar and Attiguppe, has tree-lined streets of houses with apartment buildings mixed in. Nagarbhavi's 1st and 2nd Stages are largely independent houses on layouts such as Annapoorneshwari Nagar and Vinayaka Layout. RR Nagar mixes older layouts with newer, sometimes gated, apartment projects, and Kengeri runs from satellite-town houses and builder floors to gated complexes and plotted developments towards the NICE Road.

Metro coverage is strong. The Purple Line stations at Hosahalli, Vijayanagar, Attiguppe and Deepanjali Nagar opened in November 2015, the stretch through RR Nagar to Kengeri followed in August 2021, and Challaghatta came in October 2023, so a tutor can ride along the line between Vijayanagar, RR Nagar and Kengeri. Kengeri also has a railway station on the Mysuru line near the metro. Basaveshwaranagar and Nagarbhavi have no station inside, so tutors use Rajajinagar, Vijayanagar or Attiguppe and an auto. Mysore Road, Chord Road and Magadi Road are slow in office hours, which makes a mid-evening lesson easier to reach on time.

NXTutors looks for tutors in Basaveshwaranagar, Vijayanagar, Nagarbhavi, RR Nagar and Kengeri before anyone else, then tutors who travel into this western zone, then the rest of Bengaluru, then online tutors. From that order you are sent two or three matched tutors, whether your child needs primary support, SSLC or PUC help, or a CBSE or ICSE subject specialist. Each profile carries the tutor's fee before you book, the opening lesson is a free demo, and changing tutor later costs nothing. Share your stage, block and a map pin so the distance is measured properly.
faqs: Can a tutor from Vijayanagar reach RR Nagar or Kengeri by metro?

Yes. The Purple Line links Vijayanagar, Attiguppe and Deepanjali Nagar with RR Nagar, Pattanagere and the two Kengeri stations, so a tutor can ride directly and take a short auto to the house. That route avoids Mysore Road and the Outer Ring Road, which are slow at office hours, and keeps weekday lessons punctual.
What is housing like in Nagarbhavi for a visiting tutor?

Mostly independent houses on plotted layouts, with apartment buildings on some main roads, so visits are at the doorstep and two-wheeler parking is usually easy. The Outer Ring Road runs past the area, and the nearest metro stations are Vijayanagar and Attiguppe, so tutors without a vehicle combine the metro with an auto.
What does home tuition cost in RR Nagar or Basaveshwaranagar?

Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more. You see the tutor's own fee before the demo, and we do not suggest anyone above your budget.
Does Kengeri suit a home tutor or online lessons better?

Home lessons work well because transit is strong: the Purple Line's Kengeri stations and Kengeri railway station sit close together. Newer gated complexes need the tutor on the visitor list, while satellite-town houses are doorstep visits. For the outlying layouts, or a specialist senior subject, adding an online session widens the choice of tutor.

intro: The old Cantonment zone mixes heritage homes with newer buildings. Frazer Town has heritage bungalows, older independent homes, multi-storey apartments and a few gated complexes, with Cox Town, Benson Town and Richards Town beside it. Cooke Town keeps parks and quiet lanes, though many of its bungalows have been replaced by low-rise flats and some gated apartments. Richmond Town, bordered by Shanthinagar and Langford Town, ranges from colonial-era blocks and houses to modern apartment buildings, many with a guard at the entrance. Ulsoor has old independent houses in the temple lanes, standalone apartment buildings and some gated societies around its lake, with Jogupalya and Cambridge Layout next door.

Tutor journeys differ within this small zone. Ulsoor is on the Purple Line, with Halasuru station from the first 2011 section, so tutors from Indiranagar or the centre come straight in. Richmond Town is reached from the city-centre underground stations, opened in April 2016, followed by an auto. Frazer Town and Cooke Town have no open station; the Pink Line's Pottery Town stop is under construction, so tutors come by road or by Purple Line and auto, and Bangalore East and Banaswadi railway stations are close. Shopping streets and central roads such as Richmond Road and Hosur Road fill up in the evening, so afternoon or early-evening lessons are easier to hold.

Send NXTutors your address in Frazer Town, Cooke Town, Richmond Town or Ulsoor, and the tutors we suggest are ordered by distance: those living in the zone, those who already travel here, others in Bengaluru, and online tutors if the right subject expert is further away. You receive two or three, each matched to class, board and subject and each showing a fee before you book. A free demo comes first, taught on the chapter your child is doing now, and a switch to another tutor later is free if your needs change.
faqs: Is there a metro station in Frazer Town or Cooke Town?

Not an open one. The Pink Line's underground Pottery Town station, expected to serve Frazer Town, Cox Town and Richards Town, is under construction. For now tutors arrive by road or take the Purple Line and an auto, and Bangalore East and Banaswadi railway stations are close to both localities for tutors coming by train.
How do tutors reach Ulsoor and Richmond Town?

Ulsoor is straightforward: Halasuru station on the Purple Line sits on Old Madras Road, part of the first section opened in October 2011. For Richmond Town, the nearest open stations are the underground city-centre stops, and tutors usually take an auto from there. Central roads are congested at office hours, so later evening or weekend slots are more reliable.
Do we pay anything before meeting the tutor?

No. You see each tutor's fee on the profile, choose one of the two or three matches, and the first lesson is a free demo. Regular paid lessons begin only if you decide to continue after it, and moving to a different tutor later in the year does not carry a charge.
Why do many Richmond Town buildings need the tutor's details?

Many apartment buildings there have a guard at the entrance, so give the tutor's name and flat number to security before the first class. Older colonial-era blocks and houses are simpler doorstep visits. Sharing a landmark near Richmond Road also helps a tutor who is walking in from an auto drop or the nearest station.
